description: Native Enyo one-bucket CP-only Bullet/Test80 smoke. This isolates the new proven Test80 2024 data source before adding WDL or bucket complexity.

metadata.hypothesis: The previous native attempts used a small/older Test79 source or derived Enyo/Lichess slices and failed to recover reference move choice. Test80 2024 is a recent proven Stockfish/Leela-derived NNUE binpack source. Start with one shared Enyo input bucket to avoid bucket data starvation and isolate data-source quality before adding WDL or king-bucket complexity.
metadata.data_audit: runs/native-test80-jan2024-data-audit-20260524/run.log: 1M rows sampled; result win/draw/loss 17.75/63.14/19.11; score_result_agree 83.79% on non-draws.
constraints: CP-only objective first; no WDL until the data-source effect is known
one train-time input bucket expanded to current runtime bucket count
checkpoint gate before any continuation or SPRT

validation.first_gate: checkpoint sweep at 512, 1024, 1536, and 2048 on the 800-target Lichess-policy gate, reusing the cached reference CSV.
validation.continue_only_if: This must materially beat the prior one-bucket Test79 smoke and avoid catastrophic mate-like tails.
validation.promotion: No SPRT unless checkpoint gate and failure-suite replay are clean.
